scope: A0 P1 corrective repair 2B: world-time/context progression cadence, anti-farming, and deck-drill lifecycle
changes: replaces finite recent-key anti-grind queues with rolling world-time/context cadence records
uses a seven-day semantic cadence for recurring Life Experience sources
uses a one-day semantic cadence for skill practice while retaining challenge-relative gain
prevents unrelated rotating keys from restoring full reward at the same world hour
scopes real personal-combat practice to the actual combat instance
shares repeated Deck Drill practice across a First-Mate-specific training cadence
makes Deck Drill consume two hours through the authoritative world clock
records completed drills as canonical world events
limits drill-earned First Mate respect to one point per 72 hours and a ceiling of 60
uses the actually assigned First Mate name and Blades skill instead of hardcoded Mira values
normalizes deprecated recent-key queues on save load without a schema bump
adds eight dedicated A0.2B cadence/cohesion regressions

cohesion.world_time: Deck Drill advances through advanceWorld; no second training clock or manual downstream ticking is introduced
cohesion.a0_1b_npc_planner: training time reaches NPC planning through the ordinary world-clock path and does not mutate planner state directly
cohesion.a0_1c_economy: training time reaches settlement economy/price refresh through advanceWorld; progression does not create or erase stock
cohesion.a0_2a_information: knowledge freshness ages through the same absoluteHour; progression does not write competing information truth
cohesion.crew_relationships: routine drill can build only bounded personal First Mate respect; aggregate morale/loyalty remains owned by crew mechanics
cohesion.combat: real combat uses combat-instance context while repeat training deliberately shares trainer/action context
cohesion.expansion: cadence is semantic and world-time based, with no named port/region/culture branches

saveCompatibility: schema v12 unchanged; cadence fields are additive inside existing JSON advancement/practice state and old finite recent-key queues are non-authoritative compatibility input
presentationChanged: no layout/art changes; Deck Drill message now names the current First Mate and states the two-hour time cost
deferred: A0.2C prepared effects and Arcane Strain
